summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the availability and implementation of new demographic data for ProVantage. It was noted that there are discrepancies regarding whether the new demographics exist on the beta environment or if they should be displayed in demonstrations.

One participant stated that the necessary demographic data had not yet been transferred to the beta environment due to previous issues. The ideal setup requires enabling this feature only during demonstrations, as the campaign manager is currently empty on production.

Options discussed included: 1) New demographics exist on beta but not on production; 2) Demographics are not available on beta and it is unclear what should be shown for demos; or 3) Implementing a temporary code fix (a 'hacks') which was deemed necessary by one participant, though this option was complex.

Ultimately, the immediate action taken was to disable the feature temporarily via settings, with the understanding that it can be easily re-enabled later.
decisions: The demographic data for ProVantage will remain disabled for now and can be easily enabled later via configuration.
action_items: A participant committed to addressing the transfer of demographic data to the beta environment today, following a day off.
